text:
tess (Marketing): Need a tiny launch mini-kit for upcoming webinar + inbound. Single-sheet hero that scales: desktop 1200x600, mobile 640x360, square 800x800. Low copy only: headline + one-line sub. Two messaging lanes: latency-first vs cost-first. Also require: transparent PNG, SVG source, and a 3-frame sparkline GIF. Deadline: EOD Tue.

omar (Design): Understood. Will do two layout treatments (stat-led and narrative-led), two colorways (brand blue and dark invert), and a modular CTA slot so Growth can toggle CTAs. Planning mock by tomorrow 10:30 for 11am review.

noah (Growth): Add a no-CTA variant for lift tests and a copy file with approved CTAs. Also want 2 headline options per lane.

zoe (Legal): Quick note: avoid absolute claims. Use qualifiers like "up to" or "on typical workloads" and include a tiny methodology link. I can review final copy within an hour.

assets-bot: Uploaded draft_kit_v1.zip to /Shared/marketing/launch-mini-kit/draft_kit_v1.zip (includes fig, exports, README).

omar (Design): Figma draft: https://www.figma.com/file/launchminikit/preview — org access. Will post final package (SVG + PNGs + GIF + copy slate + README) by EOD Tue.

tess (Marketing): Thanks all  I'll post the review checklist and tag reviewers once mock is in.
